node.title: Paid_tan(A): staircase formula as a computable function
node.notes: IN FLIGHT: #194 (bundle) | FLIP on replay (Codex wave 3): PROVABLE -> PROVED.
node.statement: THE TANGENT PAID COLUMN Paid_tan(A) is a computable function of the row and the agreement index A, equal to the first-match sum of (i) the explicit tangent staircase contribution supplied by `staircase` and (ii) the residual common-code-line charge supplied by `common_code_line_budget` for slopes lying on a common code line but not already counted by the primary staircase stratum. Convention: a witness is charged to the first applicable tangent cell, and residual common-line witnesses are charged thereafter. [statement written 2026-07-27 from this node's own proof.md]
